item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
What's changed

  • Fix the appcast publish step (3454b66)
  • Prepare the first Streamif release (09c445d)
  • Serve the appcast from the site instead of gh-pages (ae17723)
  • Serve the site from Cloudflare Workers (b7978e6)
  • Rework the landing page (866a83a)
  • Rename Fargo to Streamif (652548e)
  • Fargo: native macOS streaming studio (fcc8bea)

Install

Download Streamif-0.1.0-universal.dmg, drag Streamif to Applications, and launch it.

The build is a universal binary, signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple.

Requires macOS 14.0 or later. Existing installs update themselves through Sparkle.
